root.label: CBO report on US aircraft lost or damaged in Iran war

events.label: CBO report on US aircraft lost or damaged in Iran war

slots.name: aircraft lost or damaged
slots.sentence: At least 81 United States military aircraft, including fighter jets and drones, have been lost or damaged during Operation Epic Fury, the code name for Washington’s military campaign against Iran launched earlier this year.

slots.name: aircraft loss cost
slots.sentence: It estimated that, as of August 1, the cost of the American aircraft losses during the US-Israeli war against Iran was between $1.9bn and $3.3bn.

slots.name: F-15E aircraft count
slots.sentence: Monday’s report listed 12 F-15E Strike Eagle fighter jets, one F-35A Lightning II jet and seven KC-135 Stratotanker aerial refuelling aircraft among those affected.

slots.name: KC-135 aircraft count
slots.sentence: seven KC-135 Stratotanker aerial refuelling aircraft

slots.name: MQ-9 drone count
slots.sentence: Forty-five of the 81 aircraft identified in the report were MQ-9 Reaper drones.

slots.name: defense spending request
slots.sentence: Earlier this year, his administration requested a record $1.5 trillion in defence spending for fiscal year 2027, citing the demands of the war.
